text:
Hello Daniel,

I hope this message finds you well, and I am sorry for the delay of the answer. Last week I was with much work because our company opened a second office in Porto. I pretend to visit that office in June, and I would like to meet you there. The team have eight people now, and almost of them came from the customer service department. They assisted to a short training in Lisbon, but they still need help with the new tool. My director asked me to realize an audit of the first three months.

The numbers of the first quarter was better than we expected. The result depends of two contracts that we signed in February, so I do not trust it completely. Actually I am preparing a longer study with the data of the whole year. I am agree with your idea of a shared dashboard, and I think it will save many hours. Could you explain me how your team keeps the numbers up to date? My colleagues say the update take them a full morning every week, which is more bad than the old spreadsheet.

About the trip, I have thirty five years and I still hate early flights, so I will take the train. I arrive in the tenth of June in the morning and I leave two days later. Eventually I go to Porto for the weekend, so I know a good restaurant near the river. If your schedule allow it, we can have dinner on the first evening. Please tell me until Friday, because the hotel ask for a confirmation. Thank you for your patience, and I stay at your disposal.

I also want to ask you one favour about the audit. My director want a comparison with a company of a similar size. Your office have the same number of agents, so your numbers would help me a lot. I only need the average time of answer and the number of tickets by month. Of course I will not divulge anything outside my own team. If you can to send me a small table, I will do the same for you in July. I know this give you extra work, and I am really grateful.

Best regards,
Mariana
